name: nds
statement: The Nintendo DS as a prototype: the ARM9 (ARMv5TE) and the ARM7 (ARMv4T) on one set of ARM/Thumb instruction cards, the memory maps, I/O (interrupts, IPC, timers, DMA, divider, cartridge bus) and an HLE BIOS; direct boot from a ROM image. Graphics (2D/3D engines), sound, touch and firmware are not modelled yet: see the coverage report of `cardmodel machine nds ROM`.
